name: Inside Italy
summary:
Step into the heart of Italy's artistic and architectural wonders with Inside Italy, the revolutionary Meta Quest app that transforms how you experience Italy's cultural heritage.
This application brings Italy's most breathtaking monuments, hidden treasures, and iconic landmarks directly to your virtual doorstep,
all captured with stunning photorealistic detail trough cutting-edge photogrammetry. Inside Italy's meticulous 3D reconstructions preserve every intricate carving, fresco, and architectural nuance,
